batchRequest.request: Add a projected enrollment column for next year and flag schools projected to exceed capacity.

patchOf:
root = Stack([header, kpis, chartCard, tableCard, notesHeader, notes])
header = CardHeader("School Enrollment Report", "Capacity versus enrollment by school, 2024-25 school year")
kpis = SnippetCardBlock([k1, k2, k3])
k1 = SnippetCardItem("total-cap", k1l, k1r)
k1l = IconText(k1i, "neutral", "m", "District Capacity", "All schools", false, "horizontal")
k1i = Icon("building-2", "education")
k1r = BoldText("number", "6,350")
k2 = SnippetCardItem("total-enr", k2l, k2r)
k2l = IconText(k2i, "neutral", "m", "District Enrollment", "Current", false, "horizontal")
k2i = Icon("users", "people")
k2r = BoldText("number", "5,812", "+2.6%", "metric")
k3 = SnippetCardItem("util", k3l, k3r)
k3l = IconText(k3i, "neutral", "m", "Utilization", "Enrollment / capacity", false, "horizontal")
k3i = Icon("gauge", "education")
k3r = BoldText("number", "91.5%")
chartCard = Card([chartHead, chart])
chartHead = CardHeader("Capacity vs Enrollment", "By school")
chart = BarChart(schools, [capSeries, enrSeries], "grouped", "School", "Students")
schools = ["Maple Elementary", "Oak Ridge Elementary", "Lincoln Middle", "Riverside Middle", "Central High"]
capSeries = Series("Capacity", [650, 700, 1000, 900, 3100])
enrSeries = Series("Enrollment", [684, 610, 940, 872, 2706])
tableCard = Card([tableHead, tbl])
tableHead = CardHeader("Enrollment Detail", "District total included")
tbl = Table([Col("School", tSchools), Col("Capacity", tCap, "number"), Col("Enrollment", tEnr, "number"), Col("Utilization", tUtil), Col("Status", tStatus)])
tSchools = ["Maple Elementary", "Oak Ridge Elementary", "Lincoln Middle", "Riverside Middle", "Central High", "District Total"]
tCap = [650, 700, 1000, 900, 3100, 6350]
tEnr = [684, 610, 940, 872, 2706, 5812]
tUtil = ["105%", "87%", "94%", "97%", "87%", "91.5%"]
tStatus = [Tag("Over capacity", null, "sm", "danger"), Tag("Available", null, "sm", "success"), Tag("Near capacity", null, "sm", "warning"), Tag("Near capacity", null, "sm", "warning"), Tag("Available", null, "sm", "success"), Tag("Healthy", null, "sm", "info")]
notesHeader = InlineHeader("Planned Expansions", "Notes from the facilities plan")
notes = Accordion([n1, n2, n3])
n1 = AccordionItem("maple", "Maple Elementary: 6-classroom addition", [TextContent("Maple is 34 students over capacity. A 6-classroom wing adding about 150 seats is planned, with construction targeted for summer 2025 and opening in fall 2026. Portable classrooms will be used in the interim.")])
n2 = AccordionItem("riverside", "Riverside Middle: Library and classroom renovation", [TextContent("Renovation would add about 80 seats and modernize science labs. Design is under review, with a bond measure proposed for the next election.")])
n3 = AccordionItem("boundary", "Boundary review", [Callout("info", "Rebalancing under study", "Oak Ridge has about 90 open seats. A boundary review may shift some Maple attendance zones to Oak Ridge to relieve overcrowding.")])
request: Add a projected enrollment column for next year and flag schools projected to exceed capacity.
